entities.summary: Hauptmann Heinrich (Jindřich) Kostrba was an Austro-Hungarian aviator, the first which to score three victories in a single day, on 18 February 1916, and three more on 29 June 1916. He went on to amass eight aerial victories and become a squadron leader and flying ace.
